about: Shared cases for the demo key's expected-word match (journeys/demo-key-score.mjs and backend/scripts/financial_agent_fit_replay.py expect_hit). An expected word counts as a whole word; an expected number never counts as a calendar day or part of a written date. Measured 11 Nov 2026 on the 6 recorded Q1 answers: word presence credited 'apartment' from 'Larkmont Apartments' in a caveat and '14' from the 14 June seizure date.

cases.text: The sector covers both the garage and Larkmont Apartments.
It was at Travis Kell's apartment each evening.
The phone was seized on 14 June 2024.

about_wrong: Shared cases for the key's wrong words (demo-key-score.mjs wrongWords, financial_agent_fit_replay.py wrong_words): a wrong word counts anywhere in the answer except its labelled other version (a paragraph that starts 'Other version', or the paragraph under an 'Other version' heading). Measured 15 Nov 2026: a right demo Q2 answer scored wrong for naming the theft nights in its other version.
